title: Benchmark Record
description: Per-run benchmark record for a single tsc invocation under TS 6 or TS 7. Captured by the Phase 2 benchmark harness and Phase 3g benchmark suite. Fields follow test-strategy.md section 1 resource signals.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock elapsed time in milliseconds parsed from /usr/bin/time -v 'Elapsed (wall clock) time' via labeled key (anti-A3).

peak_rss_kib.description: Peak resident set size in KiB parsed from /usr/bin/time -v 'Maximum resident set size' via labeled key (anti-A3).

swap_delta_kib.description: Signed swap delta in KiB, defined as after - before. Negative values are valid when swap use decreases during the run.

oom_kill_count.description: Number of OOM kills for node/tsc workers since run start. Interpret zero only when dmesg_status is available; unavailable observability is represented separately.

dmesg_status.description: Whether dmesg was readable for this run; unavailable is not encoded as zero OOM kills.

process_count.description: Process count sampled via pgrep -fc tsc + pgrep -fc node at sample points.

diagnostic_count.description: Normalized diagnostic count (stdout+stderr). A run with exit 0 and diagnostic_count == 0 for a tsconfig the parity ledger knows emits >= 1 diagnostic is a false-speedup failure (anti-A5).

signal.description: Termination signal if killed (WTERMSIG), null if exited normally (WIFSIGNALED false).

turbo_cache_state.description: Turbo cache state from 'turbo run ... --summarize --json' parsed via json.loads. HIT, MISS, or the full parsed JSON object.

tsconfig_path.description: Repository-relative path to the tsconfig checked.

checkers.description: TypeScript 7 --checkers value (1 or 2; >2 rejected per test-strategy.md section 1).

host_idle_class.description: Host idle classification. 'idle' requires CPU idle >= 70% from vmstat 1 3. 'contaminated' if below threshold. 'invalid' if fail-closed trigger fired (swap/OOM ceiling exceeded).
